data.name: Olivia
data.gender_notes: Olivia is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin oliva, 'olive', a symbol of peace. Its root is Latin oliva. A common Christian name. Olivia is a Latin name meaning “Olive tree”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Olivia expresses “Olive tree”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin oliva, 'olive', a symbol of peace.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Olivia total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
